description: This is a PHP class definition for BuzzPostModel, which implements the Normalizable interface and utilizes traits for serialization. It models the data structure for a blog post or message object within the OrangeHRM system, including an associated employee object with various attributes. The class sets filters and attribute mappings for serialization purposes.

classes.name: BuzzPostModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing BuzzPost entities with associated employee data, implementing normalizable interface for API output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with a BuzzPost entity and sets filters and attribute mappings for serialization.

methods.name: setEntity
methods.description: Sets the entity object within the model (inherited/traced from ModelTrait).

methods.name: setFilters
methods.description: Defines which properties to include during serialization.

methods.name: setAttributeNames
methods.description: Defines the attribute names for serialized output.
